Commentary.Commentary: Welcome back for the run chase. The umpires and the players are out in the middle. Erin Thomas and Davina Perrin walk in with their blades for England Women Under-19. Maahi Madhavan has the new ball in hand and is raring to go. Let's play...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, the USA head into the break with momentum on their side, and with their array of spin options, they will fancy their chances of defending this total. As for England, it will be crucial for them to learn from their chase against Pakistan, where they went too hard too soon. This time, they will need to pace their innings smartly and take the game deep on a wicket which is on the slower side. Remember, the winner of this clash will top Group B. It should be an interesting chase. Stay tuned!

Prisha Thanawala is in for a chat. She says that this wicket suited her bowling. Mentions that she enjoyed bowling on this wicket. Tells that England's win in the 2017 Women's ODI World Cup inspired her to pick up the sport. Ends by saying that she backs the batters to gun down this total.

However, the USA found some much-needed stability through a composed partnership between captain Anika Kolan and Ritu Singh. As the pair settled in, their confidence grew, and they began to accelerate the scoring. England faltered with their bowling and missed multiple run-out opportunities due to errant throws, allowing the USA to capitalize. Anika batted through the innings, ensuring the USA reached a competitive total of 119, a score that seemed improbable at the halfway mark.

Excellent turnaround from the USA! It was a tale of two halves, with the first 10 overs leaving them reeling at 43/4. However, the next 10 overs showcased a remarkable recovery as they added 76 runs for the loss of just one wicket. After being sent into bat, the USA found themselves in early trouble at 29/3 as their top order faltered while trying to be overly aggressive. England maintained relentless pressure, which eventually got the better of Aditi Chudasma.
Lands it on middle, Pooja Ganesh slogs it over mid-wicket for a brace. USA Women Under-19 end their innings at 119/5!

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set for the action to commence. England break from their huddle and take their respective positions on the field. Disha Dhingra and Chetna Reddy Pagydyala will open the innings for the USA. England are starting with spin in the form of Tilly Corteen-Coleman. Let's play...
Before we get underway, Abigale Norgrove and Anika Kolan lead their respective sides out for the national anthems. It will be the national anthem of the USA first, followed by that of England.

PITCH REPORT - Isobel Joyce is near the deck. Joyce says it is the least humid day and looks like a good batting track. Mentions that there is some grass in the wicket and if the bowlers bowl around the good length area or a bit short they could get some movement.

The skipper of the USA Women Under-19, Anika Kolan says that they would have bowled first but they are okay with batting as well. Adds that they did basic training and mostly recovered in the hotel so it was a kind of day off. Ends by saying that they are going with the same team.

The captain of England Women Under-19, Abigale Norgrove feels that there could be some moisture on the wicket and they want to make use of it. Informs that they have made 4 changes as they want to back all 15 players. Tells that they will look to play with the same positive intent.

USA Women Under-19 (Unchanged Playing XI) - Disha Dhingra, Chetna Reddy Pagydyala, Isani Vaghela, Anika Kolan (C/WK), Aditi Chudasama, Ritu Singh, Pooja Ganesh, Pooja Shah, Chetnaa G Prasad, Maahi Madhavan, Saanvi Immadi.

England Women Under-19 (Playing XI) - Davina Perrin, Erin Thomas (In for Charlotte Stubbs), Trudy Johnson, Abigale Norgrove (C), Jemima Spence (In for Amuruthaa Surenkumar), Katie Jones (WK), Prisha Thanawala (In for Eve O'Neill), Olivia Brinsden, Grace Thompson (In for Charlotte Lambert), Tilly Corteen-Coleman, Phoebe Brett.
TOSS - England Women Under-19 win the toss and they will BOWL first.

As for the USA, their first game against Pakistan was abandoned without a ball being bowled, but when they finally got onto the park against Ireland, it turned out to be a historic day as they secured their first-ever win in the tournament's history. Now, they face their toughest challenge yet in the tournament, and it will require the Anika Kolan-led unit to be at their best in all three departments. Who will take top honours in Group B and carry that momentum into the next phase of the tournament? Stick around to find out.

The runners-up of the 2023 edition, England, are currently placed below the USA in the standings, sitting in the 2nd spot with 3 points - 2 from a win against Pakistan and 1 from the washout against Ireland. In their previous match against Pakistan, England didn't put a foot wrong with the ball, executing their plans perfectly. However, their shot selection while chasing just 67 could have been more disciplined, and that's something Abigale Norgrove and Co. will want to correct in this game.

Hello and a warm welcome, folks, to the top-of-the-table clash in Group B between England and the USA at the Johor Cricket Academy Oval. Going into the final group stage fixture, both sides are already through to the next stage, but there is still a lot to play for. The winner will top the group, and this is crucial for a couple of reasons. Not only does it help avoid a potential Super Six showdown against the winner of Group C, but since teams carry forward both their wins and net run rate against fellow qualifiers from the group, a victory here will provide a vital advantage in the next round.
... MATCH DAY ...

The final round of Group B fixtures at the 2025 ICC Women's Under-19 T20 World Cup kicks off with England Women Under-19 facing USA Women Under-19 at the Johor Cricket Academy Oval. Both teams have had identical starts to their campaigns, with a washout in their opening game followed by a victory in the next. With both sides already assured of a spot in the Super Six, this clash will determine the group winner. Finishing at the top of Group B is crucial, as it allows the winner to avoid the top-ranked team from Group C in the Super Six stage. Isani Vaghela was outstanding with the ball for the USA, helping them skittle out Ireland for just 75, which they chased down comfortably to go top of the group. Given England's struggles against slower bowlers in their match against Pakistan, the spin quartet of Aditi Chudasama, Ritu Singh, Saanvi Immadi, and Chetnaa G Prasad will play a crucial role in this contest.  As for England, they were flawless with the ball against Pakistan, with Katie Jones making a significant impact with her glovework. However, they made the chase of 67 tougher than it needed to be due to some over-aggressive shot selection. Davina Perrin, Olivia Brinsden, and Charlotte Stubbs will need to refine their approach and improve their shot choices as England aim to finish the group stage on a high. The USA will be riding high on confidence after registering their first win in the tournament's history. Can they build on this momentum to spring a surprise? We shall find out.
